captions.instagram:
Clean monthly books are what make tax season short. Pick a day, like the 10th, and work down the list:

1. Download every statement
2. Categorize every transaction
3. Reconcile each account
4. Match receipts
5. Separate personal from business
6. Review who owes you
7. Review what you owe
8. Record payroll, loans and fees
9. Read your P&L and balance sheet
10. Set aside tax

Want it done for you? We close your books every month. Prefer to do it yourself? The Month-End Close Checklist is in our shop.
